issue: Account subject classification (境内个人 vs 境外个人) is unknown.
missing: The bank's written classification and the ID document on file.
action: Ask the bank in writing for 账户主体类别 before choosing M01/M03/M18.

issue: Whether a PRC resident ID / hukou is still active for this US citizen is unknown.
missing: Hukou cancellation status and the ID used to open the account.
action: Resolve nationality/ID status with the NIA and the bank; it drives both eligibility and compliance.

issue: Source of the CNY balance (salary, property, inheritance, dividend, savings, other) is unknown.
action: Map each tranche to a source; the route and any real Chinese tax depend on it.

issue: Prior US filing history (FBAR, Form 8938, Schedule B, income on worldwide interest) is unknown.
missing: Copies of prior filings and account statements.
action: Resolve reporting before a large inbound wire; the willful-FBAR ceiling is the largest number in this dossier.

issue: The exact financial product holding the CNY is unknown (deposit vs fund / insurance / structured product).
action: Identify the product; PFIC / foreign-trust rules can dominate the US tax result.

issue: Intermediary / correspondent / receiving-bank charges are not published as a fixed number.
missing: The actual SWIFT route and the receiving bank's tariff.
action: Keep those cells blank; substitute your own bank's published tariff.

issue: The BOC posted board is explicitly 仅供参考 and is not an executable transaction quote.
missing: A live rate from online/mobile banking or a branch at the moment of conversion.
action: Treat the spread proxy as conditional arithmetic, not a price.

issue: Electronic-channel discounts (0%-100%) are published separately and were not retrieved.
missing: The specific channel's discount and validity dates.
action: The cost tables use the counter-tariff baseline; check the channel discount before transacting.

issue: No Wise public quote was retrievable above the CNY 300,000 single-transfer cap; the page returned a waiting-list notice.
missing: Logged-in quotes for a multi-transfer schedule, and the user's Wise overall limit.
action: Wise cost cells above that cap are blank and flagged.

issue: Any real PRC income tax on the underlying source (property gain, dividends, salary) cannot be computed.
missing: Cost basis, gain, withholding records and tax residency.
action: Tax cells are blank; the 20% statutory rate is shown only as conditional arithmetic.

issue: US §988 gain on the disposition of CNY cannot be computed without the acquisition rate/date.
missing: CNY acquisition dates and USD-equivalent basis.
action: US tax cells are blank; §988(e) USD 200 personal-transaction de minimis is noted.

issue: SAFE approval timing, local document checklists and any administrative charge for 移民/继承转移 were not published in the retrieved instruments.
missing: Local SAFE branch practice and fee schedule.
action: Keep these cells blank; confirm at the former-hukou SAFE branch.

issue: Inherited editions describe emigration transfers as necessarily staged over three years (50% / 25% / 25%), quoting Art. 6 of the 2004 measures without the amendment.
action: Applied the 2014 cancellation of staged release, verified on SAFE's own page.

issue: Some inherited material treats foreign-individual FIE dividends as exempt under the 1994 policy.
action: The exemption was repealed effective 2026-09-01; 20% IIT now applies.

issue: A BOC notice changes overseas ATM pricing effective 2026-11-11, two days after this edition's retrieval date.
action: This edition uses the currently effective tariff and shows the future change separately.

issue: The HSBC China PDF headed 'Effective from 31 Oct 2026' contains an embedded older table headed 2024年9月12日生效.
action: Only the top-level current tariff is used; mixed vintage is disclosed.

issue: The new 1% US remittance excise tax is sometimes described online as a tax on all inbound international transfers.
action: IR-2026-48 limits it to remittances sent FROM the US and funded with physical instruments; it does not apply here.

issue: FBAR penalty figures in older material use the statutory USD 10,000 / USD 100,000 amounts without inflation adjustment.
action: eCFR 31 CFR 1010.821 displays adjusted maxima USD 16,536 / USD 165,353 for assessments on or after 2025-01-17.

issue: Inherited editions quote a 0.42% bid/ask figure as a one-way conversion cost.
action: 0.4199% is the full round-trip board spread; the one-way half-spread proxy used here is 0.2100%.

issue: A willful FBAR penalty is sometimes quoted as 50% of the transferred amount.
action: 31 USC 5321(a)(5)(D)(ii) uses the balance in the account at the time of the violation.
